query_scenarios.query: stable porous MOFs for CO2 adsorption
photocatalytic MOFs with suitable band gaps
lightweight gas storage MOFs with low density
balanced stable MOF candidates for general materials discovery
wide band gap insulating MOFs with low density

distance_metric: masked Euclidean distance over jointly observed active objectives; no-overlap fallback = 0.0
missing_value_policy: missing descriptors carry availability_mask=false and are excluded from relevance, balance, distance, diversity, remapping, and aggregate metrics
void_fraction_policy: void fraction is unavailable for 0/20372 records and excluded from every numerical ranking calculation
semantic_proxy_method: deterministic metadata-token and application-keyword proxy over local metadata text/formula; live retrieval uses SentenceTransformer metadata embeddings in FAISS L2 index

graph_model_settings.GraphSAGE: formula-derived metadata graph proxy used for reranking because no per-record trained GraphSAGE embeddings are stored for the full 20372-record local metadata set
graph_model_settings.GAT: formula-derived metadata graph proxy used for reranking because GAT is present only as a future-extension stub in backend/app/ml/models/gat.py

train_validation_test_split: not retrained in final rerun; final ranking rerun uses existing local vector metadata and formula-derived graph proxies
